en.topic_title: How China gets the Nvidia chips it needs to develop AI
en.topic_summary:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to having an affair, reportedly with a Chinese executive at a Singapore-based company that the United States suspects of smuggling AI microchips into China.



Nvidia’s H200 chips. Photo: Nvidia.



The scandal has focused attention on how China, a major artificial-intelligence power in itself, obtains the cutting-edge chips despite US export restrictions.
